source: Derived directly from SHAPY upstream repository (mesh-mesh-intersection/data/smplx_measurements.yaml) and SMPL-X topology

HeadTop.description: Top of head vertex region on canonical mesh used for stature measurement

HeelLeft.description: Left heel contact landmark used for stature and floor distance

NippleRight.description: Right nipple landmark defining the horizontal cutting plane for chest circumference

BellyButton.description: Navel landmark defining the horizontal cutting plane for waist circumference

Crotch.description: Crotch landmark defining the horizontal cutting plane for hip circumference and inseam origin

ShoulderLeft.description: Left acromion landmark for bi-acromial shoulder width and sleeve length

ShoulderRight.description: Right acromion landmark for bi-acromial shoulder width

ElbowLeft.description: Left elbow landmark for sleeve length articulation point

WristLeft.description: Left wrist landmark for sleeve length endpoint

NeckBase.description: Base of neck / C7 level for neck circumference cutting plane

AnkleLeft.description: Left inner malleolus landmark for inseam bottom termination

tailoring_definitions.height: Vertical distance along Y axis between HeadTop and HeelLeft
tailoring_definitions.chest: 2D convex hull perimeter of mesh intersection with horizontal plane at NippleRight height
tailoring_definitions.waist: 2D convex hull perimeter of mesh intersection with horizontal plane at BellyButton height
tailoring_definitions.hips: 2D convex hull perimeter of mesh intersection with horizontal plane at Crotch height
tailoring_definitions.shoulder_width: Euclidean bi-acromial distance between ShoulderLeft and ShoulderRight
tailoring_definitions.sleeve_length: Segmented sum of Euclidean distance from ShoulderLeft to ElbowLeft and ElbowLeft to WristLeft
tailoring_definitions.inseam: Vertical Y-distance from Crotch landmark to HeelLeft landmark
tailoring_definitions.neck: 2D convex hull perimeter of mesh intersection with horizontal plane at NeckBase height
tailoring_definitions.thigh: 2D convex hull perimeter of left leg intersection with horizontal plane 5 cm below Crotch
